description: The fatal read arm, reached by a stored row that is not a CVACT01Y record: it is the account record with its trailing FILLER PIC X(178) span absent, so it measures 122 bytes where app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy declares 300. Fields are not decoded from offsets that would not be theirs; the read reports a permanent error, so 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT moves 12 into APPL-RESULT, both the 88 APPL-AOK and the 88 APPL-EOF conditions fail, and L110-L113 run: DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE', the rendered status, then the abend with RETURN-CODE 12. This is the failure mode a record-width assertion exists to catch, seen from the program's side.

expectedMessages.text: START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT01C
